body:
Part of #273. Owner product acceptance remains open on that issue.

Changing a node ID now repairs understood JSONata and Liquid references, typed mutation pointers and edge endpoints in one undoable draft edit. Dynamic or ambiguous references receive warnings; known missing gate and visit identities block publication. Published versions and pinned runs keep their original definitions. Prose, literal JSON and opaque scripts are not rewritten.

The editor preserves collection rows, open state and nested focus through reference repairs. Unapplied section JSON stays held until the author settles it, even if the repaired section becomes equal. Historical warning locations stop opening fields after that node's config changes and explain why. The domain follows actual item/thread scopes and evaluated JSONata attachments, with conservative uncertainty for decorations the installed evaluator ignores.

[ADR-0075](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/164c01a2e3a52bf0ef69a409e1a428b45817b1b8/docs/decisions/ADR-0075-node-id-reference-repair.md) records the repair boundary. GPT owns the domain/API architecture and implementation; Claude owns the editor design and implementation.

## Current candidate and gates

Head `164c01a2e3a52bf0ef69a409e1a428b45817b1b8`, tree `30af5edcf429af416a37833ea2bd21a17c752e66`, includes actual merged main `a817e5ccb4fd598ca56089b97b4ce55e9cb6f58c`. This draft contains the five accepted corrections from [formal scans 1 and 2](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/pull/474#issuecomment-6882534449). Their original change-required verdicts remain retained. F3/F4 are parked as #476/#477.

- Domain: paired identical final tests gave 23 intended assertion failures and 68 passing controls on the original source, then 91/91 passes on the correction. No-emit types, lint and formatting passed. [Paired correction evidence](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/164c01a2e3a52bf0ef69a409e1a428b45817b1b8/docs/qa/2026-11-14-node-reference-review-correction-domain/README.md)
- UI: five new regressions failed on the original source; 54 focused, 406 related and 70 final focused tests passed after correction, with web no-emit types, lint and formatting. [UI correction evidence](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/164c01a2e3a52bf0ef69a409e1a428b45817b1b8/docs/qa/2026-11-14-node-reference-review-correction-ui/README.md)
- All 374 added evidence files (6,026,623 bytes) were verified against staged and committed Git blobs. The original 1,227 compiled files and 11 build-info files were preserved for independent negative native checks.
- New [exact-head CI](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/actions/runs/43632537429) and [routing](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/actions/runs/43632537340) are running. Original-runtime negative checks, fresh candidate build and corrected independent native QA remain pending.
- Fresh whole-PR GPT-6 Astra max sign-off remains reserved as scan 3, after corrected verification and current-target CI. The three-total-scan cap is unchanged.

## Baseline evidence

The reviewed baseline `ae8add8a` passed all 22 coverage tasks, 2,510 web tests, 479 browser cases plus one expected live-provider skip with no retries, Windows 14/14, template image and routing. Dependency audit passed its configured threshold with 8 low and 13 moderate advisories. These results do not accept the corrections above. [Baseline CI](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/164c01a2e3a52bf0ef69a409e1a428b45817b1b8/docs/qa/2026-11-14-node-references-promoted-ci/README.md)

Separate baseline native QA passed five scenarios in Edge 157 with compiled gateway and file SQLite: atomic repair/held input, immutable versions and pinned executions, diagnostics versus real 422 refusal, stale-tab recovery and protected Chat. All 48 source files and 1,227 built files matched before/after; 11 browser writes, zero uncaught page errors and cleanup passed. [Baseline native evidence](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/164c01a2e3a52bf0ef69a409e1a428b45817b1b8/docs/qa/2026-11-14-node-reference-promotion-independent/README.md) · [Earlier implementation and evidence history](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/164c01a2e3a52bf0ef69a409e1a428b45817b1b8/docs/delivery/2026-11-13-four-intents-register.md)

## Post-merge owner acceptance

Record the actual merged build and observations on #273. Confirm that the repair summary and uncertainty guidance are understandable, warning navigation is predictable, and the preserved editing/focus behavior feels right in ordinary authoring. Machine-checkable behavior remains the pipeline's responsibility. No owner instance/store change or provider turn is part of this PR.
